description: This file defines the Histogram interface used for measuring statistical distributions of data streams in the project's metrics instrumentation framework.

classes.name: Histogram
classes.description: An interface for histogram metrics that track statistical distributions, allowing recording of values and retrieval of recorded data.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records a value into the histogram and returns the histogram instance for chaining.

methods.name: getRecordedValues
methods.description: Returns an array of all recorded histogram values.
